as a pre-hardened MACRO (GDS/LEF/LIB/SPEF/VH from its own completed,
fully-closed run RUN_2026-09-23_12-48-47 - DRC/LVS/Antenna/Setup/Hold
all clean, see PhysicalDesignStatus.tsx) instead of being re-synthesized
8x as part of daq_subsystem itself. This is the hierarchical track from
the P&R Research dashboard tab's flat-vs-hierarchical comparison.
VERILOG_FILES below omits chan_top.sv and its exclusive internal
dependencies (chan_ctrl.sv, pkt_align.sv, pkt_check.sv, skid_buffer.sv -
confirmed via grep that none of these are referenced by any other
daq_subsystem top-level module). Only the top-level glue (dma_sched,
desc_fetch, axi_rd_master, axi_wr_master, wr_track, csr, irq_ctrl,
perf_cnt) plus daq_subsystem.sv itself get synthesized/placed/routed
here - the 8 chan_top instances are read as blackboxes via MACROS below
(OpenLane's synthesis step auto-blackboxes any MACROS entry through
get_macro_views_by_priority - confirmed by reading openlane/steps/
yosys.py directly, no custom glue script needed).
prim_flop/prim_flop_2sync/prim_clock_mux2 are left in VERILOG_FILES
even though no current top-level module references them directly -
they may be pulled in transitively by prim_fifo_async's own internals
and are harmless if unused (yosys simply won't instantiate them).
Instance names below (gen_chan[0..7].u_chan_top) come directly from
daq_subsystem.sv's own generate-for block: `for (genvar c = 0; c <
NumCh; c++) begin : gen_chan  chan_top u_chan_top (...); end`.
FIRST PASS: instance locations are left unset ('automatic placement'
per OpenLane's own Instance dataclass docs) so OpenLane's built-in
placer positions the 8 macros itself - this validates the blackbox+
macro mechanism end-to-end before layering ParSAC's constraint-based
placement on top. See config_hierarchical_parsac.json for the second
pass once ParSAC produces real coordinates.
Launched the same way as config.json (from /mnt/d/MyWork, see
tools/wsl/1XX_run_daq_subsystem.sh) - OpenLane won't read above its
working dir, and prim/chan_top's run dir both live outside this repo's
immediate ancestry from asic/daq_subsystem/.
//DIE_AREA: Same budget as the flat config: 3200x3200 (~10.24M um^2). 8x chan_top's
own die (800x800 = 640,000 um^2 each) is 5.12M um^2 - leaves ~5.1M um^2
for the top-level glue logic (dma_sched/csr/irq/perf_cnt etc.) plus
spacing between macros.
CORRECTION (2026-09-24, first attempt failed): leaving MACROS.instances
location unset does NOT mean 'auto-placed' in OpenLane's Classic flow -
it failed at stage 20 (GeneratePDN) with [PDN-0235] Design has unplaced
macros. The 3200x3200 budget also turned out to be exactly 4x800=3200
wide with zero room for spacing if packed edge-to-edge in a 4x2 grid.
Widened to 3700x2100 (7.77M um^2) and gave every instance an explicit
location below - a simple 4x2 grid with 100um margins/gaps and a 300um
channel between the two rows for glue logic + routing. Real synthesis
data from the failed run's completed steps (06-yosys-synthesis,
13-openroad-floorplan) showed design__instance__utilization__stdcell =
0.0389 against design__core__area = 1.013e7 um^2 -> glue logic is only
~394,000 um^2, far smaller than the 8 macros combined (5.12M um^2) - so
this is a macro-dominated floorplan with the glue logic essentially
filling in around the 8 blocks. This is a first-pass grid, not an
optimized placement - ParSAC's placement is the comparison point once
this run proves the mechanism works end to end.
